text: Chapter 7's DMVs were about instance health -- sessions, CPU, memory. This lesson is narrower: which cached queries are consuming the most resources, right now, live from the plan cache, no setup required.

sys.dm_exec_query_stats has running totals for every plan in cache -- CPU time, logical reads, execution count -- accumulated since compilation. Same kind of ranking as Query Store's Top Resource Consumers, but live from cache.

Query stats gives you handles, not readable text. sys.dm_exec_sql_text converts a handle into the actual query. CROSS APPLY calls it once per row, passing that row's own handle in -- exactly the pattern it was built for.

Swap in sys.dm_exec_query_plan for the plan itself -- click the resulting XML and it renders as the same graphical plan from Lesson 45, without re-running the query with the actual plan option turned on.

Use these DMVs for what's expensive right now, live. Use Query Store for whether it was always this slow, with full plan history. Next up: closing this chapter with Intelligent Query Processing and Automatic Tuning.
